name: lantern-bingo
description: Lantern Bingo — shared-call number game in a lantern hall, on the StarHermit engine (script game): deterministic rules, starhermit:scene hall, starhermit:ui card and menus, server-refereed hosted halls.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:native
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/rules.test.js tests/session.test.js tests/save.test.mjs tests/server.test.mjs tests/hosted.test.mjs tests/jint.test.mjs tests/i18n.test.mjs && node tests/validate-content.js
